data.desc: Vision Marine Technologies Inc. (NASDAQ: VMAR) is a marine technology and recreational boating company combining proprietary marine propulsion technology with direct consumer access through its Nautical Ventures retail, service, and marina platform. Vision Marine's operations span marine technology development, recreational boat sales, service, marina operations, and related boating activities. This integrated business model connects marine technology, manufacturers, retail distribution, and customer support, with a focus on advancing the boating experience across electric and internal combustion propulsion platforms.
